dedupe_keys.name: cyprus water development department dam storage inflow rainfall and water supply statistics

description: The Water Development Department of Cyprus publishes a statistics page under its information on water reservoirs (dams and water tanks). The page, dated 3 February 2026, groups statistics on dams by calendar year (water storage in the dams and dam construction) and by hydrological year starting on 1 October (inflow of water to the dams and water storage in the dams), annual rainfall of Cyprus in the government-controlled areas by hydrological year, and water supplied from the government water works by source. Coverage is the dams and government water works of Cyprus in the areas under government control. Access is online and free on the department's page; the tables are linked from it. Caveats: the page is in Greek, the file formats behind each link were not opened, and no licence is stated. Simulation uses: reservoir storage and inflow series for water supply and drought planning models, and supply by source for demand and allocation studies. Related records: Spanish dam and reservoir inventory (data-spain-dam-reservoir-inventory) and South African monthly dam volumes (data-mzansi-amanzi-south-africa-monthly-surface-water-dam-volumes).
